prose_and_proof_audit: A is labor augmenting; h and time allocation introduced locally. Log accounting domain and omitted-skill/time terms explicit. Two observationally equivalent output decompositions do not identify innovation.

Original bounded proportional innovation law states dimensionless skill intensity, positive/zero domains, diminishing marginal response and its absence of automatic population-scale effects. Bounded increment is distinct from bounded stock; constant research is not claimed to solve infinite-horizon equilibrium.

Two-date linear no-capital specialization states dated resource costs, terminal zero research, linear preferences and finite endpoint utility. Complete derivative/strict-concavity argument includes both global endpoint thresholds and equality cases.

Appropriation applies only to the future increment, with full current cost and discount timing. Private capture, spillover, social loss and research threshold checked. Monopoly, access, entry and administrative costs explicitly limit patent-policy interpretation.

Additive skill law proved by subtracting its fixed point; positive, zero and full depreciation branches distinguished. Steady-flow maximization is separated from discounted transition welfare and the alternative proportional law.

Diffusion uses old frontier, constant skills, exact denominator1+g and distinct domestic/frontier stocks. Convex-combination invariance, contraction formula, positive-ratio asymptotic growth and zero-absorption/zero-growth boundaries proved.
Institutional and geographic channels are conditional mechanisms, with interactions, reverse causality and distributional limits; no monocause or universal ranking.

Actual AJR primary-source inspection supports dated outcome/proxy, log instrument and baseline64. Elementary IV moment derivation requires relevance and exclusion/exogeneity; original four-state worlds have identical observables and different structural intervention effects. Historical critique remains conditional and does not claim empirical replication or disproof.
Four worked examples, eight complete matched solutions, teach-back criteria and answered delayed transfer check reviewed. Flat downloadable assets reproduce synthetic model calculations only.
